_comment: Example Claude Desktop MCP client config for the IcBerg governance gateway. Copy the 'icberg' entry below into Claude Desktop's claude_desktop_config.json 'mcpServers' object (Settings -> Developer -> Edit Config). Claude gets governed query/list_pending_approvals/audit_tail tools instead of raw database credentials -- no agent-callable approve tool; approval of a held write is granted out-of-band (authenticated REST call / human UI), never by the connected agent itself -- see backend/mcp_server.py and .devdocs/PHASE3_GATES.md P3.3/P3.7.
